title: Conversation translator
lead: Talk both ways in {destination}: speak or type, and the translation shows large and can be read aloud for the person you are talking to.
noMicrophone: This browser cannot listen yet. Type the sentence instead and the translation still appears.
recordingMode: In this browser your voice is recorded first: press the microphone to start and again to send.

composer.recording: Recording {seconds}s, press the square to send

empty.title: Start a conversation
empty.hint: Use “{traveler}” to speak, and “{local}” for the person you are talking to.

quickPhrases.label: Ask for the bill
quickPhrases.text: Could I have the bill, please?

quickPhrases.label: Where is the toilet?
quickPhrases.text: Excuse me, where is the nearest toilet?

quickPhrases.label: Call a taxi
quickPhrases.text: Could you please call a taxi for me?

quickPhrases.label: I am lost
quickPhrases.text: Excuse me, I am lost. Could you help me?

noSpeech: This browser cannot read text aloud. Show the text instead.
noVoice: This phone has no {language} voice yet. Show the text instead.

errors.offline: Translating needs an internet connection. Connect first, then try again.
errors.failed: Couldn't translate this. Try again, or use a shorter sentence.
errors.micBlocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the microphone in your browser settings, or type the sentence.
errors.noSpeech: No voice was heard. Try speaking closer to the phone.
errors.micFailed: The microphone cannot be used right now. Type the sentence instead.

offlineNote: You're offline. Translating needs the internet, so sending and the microphone come back as soon as your phone reconnects.
